in_hebrew.name: Kariuki
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Kariuki הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Kikuyu language, meaning 'God's wisdom'. This name is deeply rooted in the spiritual traditions of the Kikuyu people in Kenya, where it reflects a strong connection to divine guidance and wisdom.

This name is deeply rooted in the spiritual traditions of the Kikuyu people in Kenya, where it reflects a strong connection to divine guidance and wisdom.

This name is deeply rooted in the spiritual traditions of the Kikuyu people in Kenya, where it reflects a strong connection to divine guidance and wisdom.
